'''Second Anthology''' is the 14th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in July 1998. It is the second of three anthology boxes. It contains six '''white-bordered preview''' cards (3 Light Side and 3 Dark Side): one from [[Special Edition]], two from [[Endor]], and three from [[Death Star II]]. CardGuide numbering: 14th product. MSRP $32.00.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="wook">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Second_Anthology Second Anthology] at Wookieepedia</ref>

Those six cards became tournament-legal with this product and were later printed with black borders in their expansions. The box is an 800-card storage box (desert sand, porous sliding cover) and also held eight [[Premiere Unlimited]] packs, two [[Dagobah Limited]] packs, two [[Cloud City Limited]] packs, and a complete card checklist. Those randomized packs are reprints and are not listed here.<ref name="encyc" />

== Card list ==

These six cards were '''white-bordered previews''' in the Second Anthology (July 1998). They were later printed with black borders in [[Special Edition]], [[Endor]], or [[Death Star II]]. They became tournament-legal when this product was released, and they are listed here and again under those expansions.
